title: stk env --json
description: What `stk env --json` prints on stdout: the running fixed proxy's URL, the CA path, and the environment a brokered child gets. Written from supertoolkit internal/proxyenv/env.go (`map[string]any{"proxy_url", "ca_path", "env"}`). `proxy_url` carries the proxy key, so a reader treats it as a secret. AgentPod's node-agent requires a non-empty `proxy_url` and `ca_path` (stkclient.go, Env). On failure stk exits non-zero and writes `stk: <message>` to stderr; that text and the exit code are not part of this contract (phase 4, ruling 4).

env.description: Variable name to value: the proxy and CA settings and each service's placeholder.
